_readme: The promotional-text cadence: Apple's Promotional Text can change without a new app version, so it is the one listing field
that can follow the calendar. Each entry: the dates it is live, the channels, and the text per register locale. No price and
no offer (ADR 078; a price moves and a listing nobody re-reads keeps the old one). The hi/ta text waits on their review sheets.
Graded by tooling/ci/assert-store-listings.mjs limbs A, M (promotional-text.txt's sourced 170) and C. Changing the live text
is a lead step at each `from` date.

text.en: Know what renews before it charges you. Add each subscription once and the app does the arithmetic and the remembering.
Festive-season sign-ups renew later. Put each one on the list today and get a reminder before it renews.
See this year's subscriptions in one list, with the yearly total, before the new year's renewals start.
